verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a bulk-operations capability, such as multi-select batch edits or batch actions across many files or objects. Component instance syncing and Boolean operations on selected objects are related but different features. The AI Agent and MCP server are described as building and editing scenes, not as performing bulk operations. Because these are adjacent features rather than the story's capability, they earn no partial credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
